description:
Make the shared memory executor set up its repository through product initialisation instead of hand-written configuration.

## Background

`crate::commands::test_helpers::memory_executor` seeds `[worktree] enforce_leases = "off"` and the data-root ignore file by hand; `TestHarness` (`crate::test_harness`) builds on it, and library command tests (`commands/{batch_create,bulk_update,dependency,gate_check,gate,issue,mod,validate}.rs`) call it. Product initialisation runs over any repository-state store. A second copy in the `fast_rules` suite root writes a literal index body.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The shared `memory_executor` seeds configuration and index by running product initialisation over the memory store, and writes no literal configuration, schema version or index body.
- [hard] REQ-02: `TestHarness` builds on it, and a library test that relied on the former fixture configuration declares that value itself and keeps the property it asserted.


Scope (steward ruling): this task adds the shared definition only; existing copies are retired by the adoption tasks that depend on it.
title: Memory executor initialised through product initialisation
